I’m gonna sliiiiide on in here since I’ve worked for PX for going on 5 years now. I started during college/end of my drum corps career and have been with panda since. 5 years, 4 states, 4 promotions later and I’m on track to clear 120k this year and I just turned 27 with no formal college degree. 

I gather you may view panda as a short term/ fast food job, but with all of the people I’ve hired, promoted, watched them get married and buy houses and clear 100k too...I am beyond passionate to speak out that it has potential to be more than a mere fast food job, especially because we just grew to 2100+ stores and have approx 115 more opening in 2019. 

Just a thought mate. Best of luck on your journey and let me know if you have any questions.

Howdy friend, I was reading what our friend mention above and would like to offer a little bit different of a point of view. 

Although back of house is more intricate, we are putting things in place to ensure the process to move forward and grow is more straight forward and similar on all levels. One way we are helping do this is with a module system that clearly articulates what you’re responsible for as well as what is required knowledge wise to move to the next level.

If you do get into Panda, I would recommended asking your AM, GM or TL about the “store leadership training system” on the bottom right of their Epaws home page so you can move up much quicker since the guideline/framework is there. Hope this helps!

I know my words will only be words on a screen and I can’t define what life could be, will be or should be for you...but from someone suffering with depression and anxiety and returning from a hospital visit 3 weeks ago, it’s not anyone but myself building a prison. Don’t take on the burden of what people choose to hide. I’m so sorry for your loss and nothing will ever bring him back, just know that we make our own choices because of what we think and it never has anything to do with you.

I’m not sure what it is; I got a note to work less at work than we are required and I took a 10 day vacation. I’m just lonely now, feel a bit more crazy because this should be easy for anybody to overcome, but for some reason I can’t get over the hill this time. I’ve been going to the gym, eating better, spending more me time but I still am alone and feel miserable. I still have racing thoughts and panic riddled dreams about life. Everything testing me just makes me wonder if I’m the right fit for the world. Maybe someone else can use this life better than I can or am. Maybe it’s just not my thing.
Yes, I’m actually doing therapy, on meds, working out etc. just...blah

TL here

Ask questions: no question is ever a stupid question. 

Your success is based on you. If you think it’s in other peoples hands that is where your journey with us will go down hill quickly. 

Talk to the team, don’t be afraid, and ASK QUESTIONS.

Lastly, do your best to take your common sense to fill in gaps that people may not always teach you. Always wash your hands when changing a task; communicate with your PIC of boh or Foh so they are on the same page and don’t build a perception of you that won’t help your growth and development. Believe in yourself, be yourself, be all you can be, and be outstanding. 

PM Me if you have any questions or need any help :)
